content.text: The node ID provided was invalid. Please ensure the node ID was extracted correctly from the URL. For example, if given the URL https://figma.com/design/:fileKey/:fileName?node-id=1-2, the extracted nodeId would be `1:2`. The node ID could also be invalid if it refers to a sublayer of an instance, since those node IDs do not persist. Ask the user to try the top-level instance if that is the case. If the node ID was extracted correctly, please ask the user to confirm the node is still in the file.
